author: sputnikf111
quote: The original vision for what became grand theft auto was called “Race & Chase” it was about running away from cops, because that was fun. The new honour system completely ruined that premise. The game is slow and boring. The performance is disgraceful considering how many delays this game had. The game is overwhelmingly sanitised to fit current agenda, this feels like a propaganda tool. They don’t care if they lose money they just have to get “the message” out there. When the new saints row failed to gain traction, they took most of the same ideas and shoehorned them into this. It’s clear that Jason was not the original main protagonist, but they knew no one would consume the agenda if a male wasn’t in it. It’s like going to your favourite restaurant, ordering what you know you will like, and to be served feces instead. IMHO, they should pull it, rework it, and re release next year. My suggestions are, remove Lucia or make her another npc.
